rules.pointer: The first useful journey is to add Rice, mark it needed, view Rice on the shopping list, and reload with that decision retained.
UI code never accesses localStorage directly, including bare, property and destructuring forms.
Run the standalone checker in this checkout and a different-root clean clone with isolated home and cache.

acceptanceSources.pointer: The first useful journey is to add Rice, mark it needed, view Rice on the shopping list, and reload with that decision retained.
Re-adding an equivalent full name preserves the existing needed mark; only an explicit needed-state change alters that shopping decision.
When local storage saving fails, the current session remains usable and unsaved changes are visible.
Browser rendering APIs such as document.createElement and window.requestAnimationFrame are permitted.
